vocab_words.example: Performance appraisals are held twice a year.
She decided to resign after ten years.
New hires undergo a three-month probation period.
The candidate impressed the interview panel.
The company handled the complaint promptly.
Customers can request a refund within 30 days.
We received an inquiry about the product warranty.

vocab_words.meaning: phản hồi, ý kiến đóng góp
vocab_words.example: Customer feedback helps us improve our service.
The staff were courteous and helpful.
The team worked to resolve the issue quickly.

items.question: The manager will be ___ for approving all expense reports.
The seminar covers topics ___ ranging from finance to marketing.
items.explanation: Không cần đại từ quan hệ vì "ranging" đã là dạng rút gọn của mệnh đề quan hệ.

items.question: The product needs to be tested thoroughly ___ it is released.
items.explanation: Ngữ cảnh cần kiểm tra trước khi phát hành, dùng liên từ "before".

items.question: The staff were given clear instructions ___ how to use the new system.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "instructions on how to...".

items.question: The board members ___ discussing the proposal when the fire alarm went off.
items.explanation: Thì quá khứ tiếp diễn diễn tả hành động đang xảy ra thì bị gián đoạn.

items.question: The report contains ___ information than we expected.
items.explanation: So sánh hơn với danh từ không đếm được "information" dùng "more".

items.question: The negotiation process took longer ___ anyone had anticipated.
items.explanation: So sánh hơn dùng "than", không phải "then".

items.question: The number of customer complaints has ___ decreased since the new policy.
items.explanation: Cần trạng từ (adverb) để bổ nghĩa cho động từ "decreased".

items.question: The training session was ___ informative that attendees asked for a follow-up.
items.explanation: Cấu trúc "so + adj + that" diễn tả kết quả.

items.question: She is responsible ___ managing the entire logistics department.
items.explanation: Cụm cố định "be responsible for + V-ing/danh từ".
